3.speaker: Narrator
3.text: It had been several days since I'd had Karl Greiser detain Livia and Petr. Word was about to get out that both the vice president and the president's secretary were in jail.

10.speaker: Narrator
10.text: It had been several days since I'd had Karl Greiser secretly arrest Livia and Petr. It wouldn't be long before word got out that both the vice president and the president's secretary had gone missing.
10.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Turn08_SecondScandal_Detained_Livia"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Turn08_SecondScandal_Detained_Petr"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Turn08_SecondScandal_SecretState_ArrestLivia"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Turn08_SecondScandal_SecretState_ArrestPetr"] == true)

11.speaker: Narrator
11.text: It had been several days since I'd had Karl Greiser secretly kill Livia and Petr. It wouldn't be long before word got out that both the vice president and the president's secretary had gone missing.
11.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Turn08_SecondScandal_Detained_Livia"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Turn08_SecondScandal_Detained_Petr"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Turn08_SecondScandal_SecretState_ArrestLivia"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Turn08_SecondScandal_SecretState_ArrestPetr"] == true) == false)

12.speaker: Narrator
12.text: At Lucian's urging, I had arranged a press conference to get ahead of the narrative.

14.speaker: Lucian Galade
14.conditionsRaw: Variable["BaseGame.Accepted_MediaDeal"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Turn07_Detained_MarcelKoronti"] == false  and  Variable["BaseGame.Relations_Marcel_Enemy"] == false

15.speaker: Lucian Galade
15.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Accepted_MediaDeal"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Turn07_Detained_MarcelKoronti"] == false  and  Variable["BaseGame.Relations_Marcel_Enemy"] == false) == false

16.speaker: Narrator
16.text: Of course, our deal with Marcel Koronti meant journalists wouldn't be asking too many questions. Still, one had to keep up appearances.
16.conditionsRaw: Variable["BaseGame.Accepted_MediaDeal"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Turn07_Detained_MarcelKoronti"] == false  and  Variable["BaseGame.Relations_Marcel_Enemy"] == false

17.speaker: Narrator
17.text: I was still reeling from the loss of two of my closest colleagues -- and my former best friend. I had to get my story straight.
17.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Accepted_MediaDeal"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Turn07_Detained_MarcelKoronti"] == false  and  Variable["BaseGame.Relations_Marcel_Enemy"] == false) == false

18.speaker: Narrator
18.text: The conference was slated to begin soon. I rang up Karl.

26.speaker: Player
26.text: "You're positive the bodies won't be found?"
26.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Turn08_SecondScandal_SecretState_ArrestLivia"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Turn08_SecondScandal_SecretState_ArrestPetr"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Turn08_SecondScandal_Detained_Livia"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Turn08_SecondScandal_Detained_Petr"] == true) == false)

27.speaker: Player
27.text: "How exactly did you dispose of Mr. Vectern and Ms. Suno?"
27.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Turn08_SecondScandal_SecretState_ArrestLivia"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Turn08_SecondScandal_SecretState_ArrestPetr"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Turn08_SecondScandal_Detained_Livia"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Turn08_SecondScandal_Detained_Petr"] == true) == false)

28.speaker: Player
28.text: "Where exactly are Mr. Vectern and Ms. Suno being held?"
28.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Turn08_SecondScandal_SecretState_ArrestLivia"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Turn08_SecondScandal_SecretState_ArrestPetr"] == true) and (Variable["BaseGame.Turn08_SecondScandal_Detained_Livia"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Turn08_SecondScandal_Detained_Petr"] == true) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Turn08_SecondScandal_Detained_Livia"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Turn08_SecondScandal_Detained_Petr"] == true) == false)

29.speaker: Player
29.text: "How are Mr. Vectern and Miss Suno holding up in detention?"
29.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Turn08_SecondScandal_SecretState_ArrestLivia"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Turn08_SecondScandal_SecretState_ArrestPetr"] == true) and (Variable["BaseGame.Turn08_SecondScandal_Detained_Livia"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Turn08_SecondScandal_Detained_Petr"] == true) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Turn08_SecondScandal_Detained_Livia"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Turn08_SecondScandal_Detained_Petr"] == true) == false)

30.speaker: Karl Greiser
30.text: "In individual cells on the top floor of Antel Rock, sir. Accessible by two guards, each of whom know only half of the combination required to enter."

31.speaker: Karl Greiser
31.text: "Mr. Vectern is still quite shaken, sir. Miss Suno appears calmer, although she continues to ask for a lawyer."

32.speaker: Karl Greiser
32.text: "They've both been dissolved in an extremely powerful acidic solution, sir. No trace has been left."

35.speaker: Karl Greiser
35.text: "My men and I do what we must to serve Sordland, sir."

38.speaker: Player
38.text: "Tell the guards Petr can have a little steak once in a while. As a treat."

41.speaker: Narrator
41.text: The moment I hung up. Lucian knocked on my door.

42.speaker: Narrator
42.text: It was late in the afternoon, and I was nervously pacing around my office. My new secretary would start next week.

44.speaker: Narrator
44.text: He and I made our way to the downstairs conference room. A dozen journalists were already waiting, notepads at the ready. They all stood up when we entered.

48.speaker: Narrator
48.text: The journalists started talking. I motioned for quiet.

49.speaker: Player
49.text: "Rest assured that both offenders have been dealt with."

50.speaker: Player
50.text: "Unfortunately, before they could be punished for their misdeeds, both disappeared. It is assumed that they ran away together."

51.speaker: Player
51.text: "Rest assured that the offenders have now been imprisoned."

55.speaker: Player
55.text: "I am currently reviewing highly qualified candidates for both positions."

56.speaker: Player
56.text: "This incident shall not interfere with the completion of my presidential goals."

57.speaker: Player
57.text: "The rest of my staff is now under investigation to root out any other potential wrongdoing."

58.speaker: Narrator
58.text: By now the reporters were nearly jumping out of their seats, hands raised.

59.speaker: Lucian Galade
59.text: "Please be aware that the president only has time to answer a limited number of questions."

60.speaker: Narrator
60.text: He gestured to the reporter at the far end of the table.

66.speaker: Reporter
66.text: "Mr. President, how are you personally coping with this horrifying betrayal? It must be very hard on top of all the other stress you have to face in office."
66.conditionsRaw: Variable["BaseGame.Accepted_MediaDeal"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Turn07_Detained_MarcelKoronti"] == false  and  Variable["BaseGame.Relations_Marcel_Enemy"] == false

68.speaker: Lucian Galade
68.conditionsRaw: Variable["BaseGame.Accepted_MediaDeal"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Turn07_Detained_MarcelKoronti"] == false  and  Variable["BaseGame.Relations_Marcel_Enemy"] == false

69.speaker: Lucian Galade
69.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Accepted_MediaDeal"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Turn07_Detained_MarcelKoronti"] == false  and  Variable["BaseGame.Relations_Marcel_Enemy"] == false) == false

70.speaker: Narrator
70.text: I said a silent prayer of thanks to Marcel Koronti.

71.speaker: Player
71.text: "Not very well, to be honest. But the pain will pass in time."

72.speaker: Player
72.text: "I don't have time to dwell on it. I must move forward so I can continue to do the same with Sordland."

73.speaker: Player
73.text: "About as well as can be expected. I'm looking forward to having this all behind me."

74.speaker: Narrator
74.text: She and the other reporters nodded.

78.speaker: Player
78.text: "I would like to address the growing rumors concerning Vice President Petr Vectern and my secretary, Livia Suno."

79.speaker: Player
79.text: "I am here to address an incident involving Vice President Petr Vectern and my secretary, Livia Suno."

80.speaker: Player
80.text: "Unbeknownst to me and the rest of the administration, these two employees were carrying on a lurid affair in flagrant defiance of Sordish values."

81.speaker: Player
81.text: "Unbeknownst to my administration, these two employees were plotting a conspiracy to remove me from office."

85.speaker: Reporter
85.text: "Mr. President, wouldn't you agree that imprisonment is a rather harsh sentence for a simple affair?"
85.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Accepted_MediaDeal"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Turn07_Detained_MarcelKoronti"] == false  and  Variable["BaseGame.Relations_Marcel_Enemy"] == false) == false) and (Variable["BaseGameIsolated.Turn08_LiviaPetrGone_Motivation_Affair"] == true) and (Variable["BaseGameIsolated.Turn08_LiviaPetrGone_Excuse_Prison"]) and ((Variable["BaseGameIsolated.Turn08_LiviaPetrGone_Excuse_RanAway"]) == false)

92.speaker: Reporter
92.text: "Mr. President, can either Miss Suno or Mr. Vectern be reached for comment about this incident?"
92.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Accepted_MediaDeal"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Turn07_Detained_MarcelKoronti"] == false  and  Variable["BaseGame.Relations_Marcel_Enemy"] == false) == false) and (Variable["BaseGameIsolated.Turn08_LiviaPetrGone_Motivation_Affair"] == true) and ((Variable["BaseGameIsolated.Turn08_LiviaPetrGone_Motivation_Affair"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGameIsolated.Turn08_LiviaPetrGone_Excuse_Prison"]) == false) and (Variable["BaseGameIsolated.Turn08_LiviaPetrGone_Excuse_Fired"]) and ((Variable["BaseGameIsolated.Turn08_LiviaPetrGone_Excuse_RanAway"]) == false)

96.speaker: Reporter
96.text: "Mr. President... what exactly do you mean by 'dealt with'?"
96.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Accepted_MediaDeal"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Turn07_Detained_MarcelKoronti"] == false  and  Variable["BaseGame.Relations_Marcel_Enemy"] == false) == false) and (Variable["BaseGameIsolated.Turn08_LiviaPetrGone_Motivation_Affair"] == true) and ((Variable["BaseGameIsolated.Turn08_LiviaPetrGone_Motivation_Affair"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGameIsolated.Turn08_LiviaPetrGone_Excuse_Prison"]) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGameIsolated.Turn08_LiviaPetrGone_Excuse_Fired"]) == false) and (Variable["BaseGameIsolated.Turn08_LiviaPetrGone_Excuse_DealtWith"]) and ((Variable["BaseGameIsolated.Turn08_LiviaPetrGone_Excuse_RanAway"]) == false)

100.text: "Mr. President, what evidence of this conspiracy do you have that would warrant imprisonment?"
100.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Accepted_MediaDeal"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Turn07_Detained_MarcelKoronti"] == false  and  Variable["BaseGame.Relations_Marcel_Enemy"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGameIsolated.Turn08_LiviaPetrGone_Motivation_Affair"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGameIsolated.Turn08_LiviaPetrGone_Excuse_DealtWith"]) == false) and (Variable["BaseGameIsolated.Turn08_LiviaPetrGone_Excuse_Prison"]) and ((Variable["BaseGameIsolated.Turn08_LiviaPetrGone_Excuse_Fired"]) == false)

101.speaker: Reporter
101.text: "Mr. President, are you attempting to track the co-conspirators down?"
101.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Accepted_MediaDeal"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Turn07_Detained_MarcelKoronti"] == false  and  Variable["BaseGame.Relations_Marcel_Enemy"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGameIsolated.Turn08_LiviaPetrGone_Motivation_Affair"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGameIsolated.Turn08_LiviaPetrGone_Excuse_DealtWith"]) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGameIsolated.Turn08_LiviaPetrGone_Excuse_Prison"]) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGameIsolated.Turn08_LiviaPetrGone_Excuse_Fired"]) == false)

105.speaker: Reporter
105.text: "Mr. President, do you have any idea where Mr. Vectern and Miss Suno could have gone?"
105.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Accepted_MediaDeal"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Turn07_Detained_MarcelKoronti"] == false  and  Variable["BaseGame.Relations_Marcel_Enemy"] == false) == false) and (Variable["BaseGameIsolated.Turn08_LiviaPetrGone_Motivation_Affair"] == true) and (Variable["BaseGameIsolated.Turn08_LiviaPetrGone_Excuse_RanAway"])

106.speaker: Player
106.text: "Yes, we've got our best men on the case."

107.speaker: Player
107.text: "Unfortunately, they covered their tracks too well."

108.speaker: Player
108.text: "The state is under attack, and you're asking about evidence?"

109.speaker: Player
109.text: "I cannot disclose the evidence at this time."

111.speaker: Player
111.text: "Both have expressed a refusal to speak to the media."

112.speaker: Player
112.text: "The state has exercised its discretion as to the appropriate punishment."

113.speaker: Player
113.text: "Both are currently taking some time away from Holsord to reflect on their misbehavior."

114.speaker: Player
114.text: "Our values are under attack, and you're asking whether prison is too harsh?"

116.speaker: Player
116.text: "No. They covered their tracks too well."

117.speaker: Player
117.text: "Possibly the border. We've got our best men on the case."

118.speaker: Reporter
118.text: "And exactly how long will the sentence be?"

119.speaker: Reporter
119.text: "And where exactly are they located right now?"

120.speaker: Reporter
120.text: "And what evidence do you have of this so-called conspiracy?"

122.speaker: Reporter
122.text: "And were you aware of the multiple affairs Mr. Vectern is rumored to have previously conducted?"

124.speaker: Player_Italic
124.text: Gesture to Lucian to end the press conference.

127.speaker: Lucian Galade
127.text: "Thank you for your time, ladies and gentlemen. That will be all for today."

128.speaker: Narrator
128.text: The reporters reluctantly left the conference room, leaving Lucian and myself alone.

132.speaker: Lucian Galade
132.conditionsRaw: Variable["BaseGame.Accepted_MediaDeal"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Turn07_Detained_MarcelKoronti"] == false  and  Variable["BaseGame.Relations_Marcel_Enemy"] == false

133.speaker: Lucian Galade
133.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Accepted_MediaDeal"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Turn07_Detained_MarcelKoronti"] == false  and  Variable["BaseGame.Relations_Marcel_Enemy"] == false) == false

134.speaker: Lucian Galade
134.text: "Marcel Koronti has come through for us yet again. I'm not sure how much longer we can count on his kindness."
134.conditionsRaw: Variable["BaseGame.Accepted_MediaDeal"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Turn07_Detained_MarcelKoronti"] == false  and  Variable["BaseGame.Relations_Marcel_Enemy"] == false

135.speaker: Lucian Galade
135.text: "The press may have been left with some dangling questions. But if Mr. Greiser did his job correctly, they'll never find the answers."
135.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Accepted_MediaDeal"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Turn07_Detained_MarcelKoronti"] == false  and  Variable["BaseGame.Relations_Marcel_Enemy"] == false) == false

138.speaker: Lucian Galade
138.text: "Very well. We shall discuss it tomorrow."

140.speaker: Player
140.text: "You're a little old to be my secretary, Lucian."

141.speaker: Lucian Galade
141.text: "In the meantime, sir, there's the matter of replacing both your secretary and your vice president."

142.speaker: Player
142.text: "I have a few candidates in mind."

143.speaker: Narrator
143.text: We left the conference room. On the long walk back to my office, I started to think about who my new vice president should be.
